app.subtitle: Would a different investment have done better with your money? Hindsight replays your deposits and withdrawals in an alternative, such as an index ETF, Bitcoin or a mix: each deposit buys it, each withdrawal sells some. The method is a Public Market Equivalent (Long–Nickels).
app.realUnavailable: No inflation data, so no real figures.
app.title: Hindsight

table.maxDrawdownInfo: Largest fall from a previous high, time-weighted, so deposits and withdrawals don't count. Alternatives use the asset's price, your portfolio Wealthfolio's daily valuations. Always nominal; matches the Performance page for the same accounts. Hover for the dates.
table.ddUnavailable: Needs a valuation of every selected account on each booking day; Wealthfolio's history has gaps.

shortfall.title: Uncovered withdrawal
shortfall.p1: This alternative was worth less than a withdrawal; only the covered part counts. Compare gains, not end values.

lateStart.title: Late start
lateStart.p1: No prices before this date. The money waits uninvested and is bought then.
lateStart.partial: A component has no prices before this date. Its share waits uninvested and is bought then; the rest is invested as usual.

info.start: Your portfolio's value at the start of the period. Every line starts with it as a deposit.
info.bookings: Bookings in the period. Amounts are netted per day; alternatives count only covered withdrawals.
info.vs: This alternative's gain minus yours, with the same deposits and withdrawals.

mix.title: Create a mix
mix.description: Deposits split by weight, withdrawals sell pro rata. Rebalancing restores the weights on a schedule or once a share drifts past the threshold.
mix.rebalanceInfo_monthly: First trading day of each month
mix.rebalanceInfo_quarterly: First trading day of each quarter
mix.rebalanceInfo_yearly: First trading day of each year
mix.rebalanceInfo_threshold: When a share drifts too far from its weight
mix.name: Name
mix.hintAssets: Choose an asset for every row.
mix.hintInvalid: Weights must be above 0 with at most two decimals; assets must differ.
mix.hintBand: The threshold must be 0.1 to 50 pp, with at most one decimal.
mix.hintDuplicate: This mix is already in the list.

guide.shows1: Gain difference: the alternative's gain minus yours. Above zero, it would have earned more with exactly your cash flows.
guide.shows2: MWR p.a.: money-weighted yearly return (XIRR) on the same cash flows; for periods under a year, over the period.
guide.shows3: Value chart: each line's value over time. The dashed “Net in” line is money paid in minus money taken out.
guide.shows4: Difference chart: each line's gain minus yours on that day. Your portfolio is the zero line; the last point is the gain difference.
guide.shows5: Max drawdown: the largest fall from a high, time-weighted. It shows how bumpy the ride was, not which did better.
guide.shows6: Real: gain and MWR in end-of-period purchasing power (OECD consumer prices for your country). Values and the gain difference stay the same.
guide.assumes1: No taxes or fees for alternatives; your portfolio includes those you paid.
guide.assumes2: Deposits buy at the adjusted close (Yahoo Finance) of their day or the next trading day; withdrawals sell. Distributions are reinvested.
guide.assumes3: Withdrawals count only as far as the alternative's value covers them.
guide.assumes4: Before an asset's first price, the money waits uninvested.
guide.assumes5: Only money from outside counts, not transfers between the selected accounts.
guide.assumes6: Incoming asset transfers count at their booking price, else Wealthfolio's price that day. Worthless ones (e.g. spam tokens) are ignored.
guide.assumes7: A period starting after your first deposit treats your portfolio's value that day as a deposit.
guide.assumes8: A mix rebalances only on days every asset has a price. Its drawdown is the strategy's, not the simulated position's.
